, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: After being instructed to navigate to and extract entries from the “Promoted in November 2016” section, WebSurfer merely reloaded the same 2016 promotions page and stayed at the top (showing December), failing to scroll/find the November section or extract the dinosaur entry and nominator.
